newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy mkt sees o/n rate falling in month.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy mkt sees o/n rate falling in month.

text.p: Italy's money market still expects overnight rates to fall in the coming month but the implicit rate has firmed a fraction from last week's expectations, a study by the Bocconi University research arm Igier showed.

The study released on Friday showed the implicit overnight rate was 7.56 percent on a one month horizon, just above the current 7.50 discount rate and against an actual overnight rate close of 8.00 percent on Thursday, the day on which the Igier study is based.
One week ago the implicit overnight rate was 7.43 percent over a one-month horizon, while one month ago it was seen standing at 7.78 percent.
On a three-month timeframe, the implicit overnight rate is seen at 6.89 percent from 6.84 percent forecast a week ago and 7.44 percent a month ago.
On a one-year horizon, the implicit overnight rate is expected at 6.05 percent, little changed from 6.06 a week ago but down from 6.90 percent seen a month ago.
On a two-year timeframe the implicit overnight rate is forecast at 6.76 percent from 6.73 percent forecast a week ago and 7.33 percent seen a month ago.

The spread between the Italian implicit overnight rate and the German implicit overnight rate two years' hence, which is seen as a good indicator of market confidence in European monetary union, is 202 basis points after 187 basis points a week ago and 236 basis points a month ago.
